metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the wherry, the passage at Whitehall, the reckoning, the picture of the table, the velvet put off until autumn, and the line entered in the book.

yesterday: The wherry was twopence a man. The bag held twenty pound. Your part is thirty-seven shillings and sixpence, entered as received.
The stock keeps its own share. Edith's eight shillings comes out of that share on Thursday.
Seven yards of peach velvet wait until autumn.
The letter, the horse, and Field's chronicle are still on the list.
